parsed.reason: Description A says the metadata file is replaced before the blob write, so a failed blob write leaves inconsistent metadata/blob state. Description B says the mutable default dict `{}` is shared across calls and mutated by setdefault, so content-type sticks across uploads. Both touch the same put method but identify different failures: an ordering/atomicity issue versus a mutable default argument bug.
